main_inner_radius = main_outer_radius - pipe_wall_thk
branch_outer_radius = pipe_outer_dia / 2.0
branch_inner_radius = branch_outer_radius - pipe_wall_thk

branch_pipe = branch_outer - branch_inner

tee = main_pipe + branch_pipe

tee = tee + rib

tee = chamfer(branch_end_face.edges(), chamfer_size)
